summary: The compliance review of LendCircle: Peer-to-Peer Personal Loans identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. A high-risk finding was identified under DLD2025:9(ii), where the use of an escrow account maintained by a bank trustee contradicts the requirement for direct repayment into the RE’s bank account. Another high-risk finding was identified under DLD2025:17(vi), where the product feature may misrepresent RBI involvement or endorsement. Medium-risk findings were identified under DLD2025:6(iii), DLD2025:6(i), and DLD2025:8(i), related to missing disclosures in loan offers and the absence of a Key Fact Statement (KFS).
